These changes feel right. Showing both the icon and the small preview is useful, and the list still feels readable rather than crowded.

The clickable, narrowing tag suggestions work the way I’d expect. Please make sure selecting an existing tag reuses it rather than creating a differently capitalized duplicate.

The larger note and rendered formatting are also good. I’d expect other common Markdown formatting, such as links, to render safely too, but this demonstrates the behavior I want. I’m happy with this saving flow—let’s try finding the bookmark and then the duplicate case.
